+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import re
+
+from .utils import make_default_short_help
+
+
+def command_catalog(
+    commands: cabc.Iterable[tuple[str, str]], width: int = 45
+) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
+    """Return command names and concise help descriptions in input order.
+
+    Each description uses the first sentence of the first paragraph, with
+    whitespace collapsed and any leading no-wrap marker removed. Descriptions
+    longer than ``width`` are shortened at a word boundary and end with ``...``.
+
+    :raises ValueError: If ``width`` is less than 4.
+    """
+    if width < 4:
+        raise ValueError("width must be at least 4")
+
+    catalog = []
+
+    for name, help_text in commands:
+        paragraph = re.split(r"\r?\n[^\S\r\n]*\r?\n", help_text, maxsplit=1)[0]
+        paragraph = paragraph.lstrip().removeprefix("\b")
+        catalog.append((name, make_default_short_help(paragraph, width)))
+
+    return catalog

+import pytest
+
+from click.command_catalog import command_catalog
+
+
+def test_catalog_preserves_input_order_and_contents():
+    commands = [
+        ("z", "First sentence. Second sentence."),
+        ("a", ""),
+        ("z", "A" * 46),
+    ]
+    original = commands.copy()
+
+    assert command_catalog(iter(commands)) == [
+        ("z", "First sentence."),
+        ("a", ""),
+        ("z", "..."),
+    ]
+    assert commands == original
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("help_text", "width", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("\t\b\nRead\t the\n file. Ignore this.", 45, "Read the file."),
+        ("\bRead the file", 45, "Read the file"),
+        ("Read the file\n\nIgnore this.", 45, "Read the file"),
+        ("Read the file\r\n \t\r\nIgnore this.", 45, "Read the file"),
+        ("Read file.txt here. Ignore this.", 45, "Read file.txt here."),
+        ("Read the file", 13, "Read the file"),
+        ("Read the file.", 11, "Read the..."),
+        ("A long description.", 4, "A..."),
+        ("Long description.", 4, "..."),
+    ],
+)
+def test_catalog_description(help_text, width, expected):
+    assert command_catalog([("read", help_text)], width) == [("read", expected)]
+
+
+def test_catalog_rejects_width_below_four():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="width"):
+        command_catalog([], 3)
